description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Creatives' that renders a dashboard interface for managing and analyzing advertising creatives. It includes metrics summaries, filtering options, detailed creative cards, performance analysis by creative type, insights, and a performance summary table.

methods.name: getCreativeIcon
methods.description: Returns an icon component based on the creative type.

methods.name: getCreativeTypeColor
methods.description: Returns a background color class based on the creative type.

methods.name: getPerformanceRating
methods.description: Provides a performance rating, color, and icon based on CTR value.

methods.name: getFilteredCreatives
methods.description: Filters and sorts the list of creatives based on selected type and sorting criteria.
